description: This file contains an immutable Java class 'ImmutableEffectedPermissions' implementing 'EffectedPermissions', handling permissions data with JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing methods to create and compare permission objects.

classes.name: ImmutableEffectedPermissions
classes.description: Immutable implementation of EffectedPermissions, managing granted and revoked permissions, with JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: of

methods.description: Creates an EffectedPermissions instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns permissions based on the specified effect (GRANT or REVOKE).
